components.text: Evidence regarding readmission rates following knee replacement varies by surgical approach. Enhanced Recovery After Surgery (ERAS) protocols have been shown to have no significant effect on or do not increase readmission rates compared to traditional care ^[1], ^[2]. Conversely, day-case knee and hip replacement has been associated with significantly lower odds of readmission compared to inpatient surgery, though this evidence is limited by a high risk of selection bias ^[3].
